name: Bram
profile: A turnip farmer. Was asleep during the vote and so did not object to being the subject of a prophecy. Owns one hoe and a great deal of unearned confidence.

name: Merribell
profile: Village healer. Her order holds that theology is a distraction from the actual problem, which is usually that you have not had any water today.

name: Hob
profile: Blacksmith. Talks to his hammers. Two of the hammers have names, and one of them, he insists, talks back.

name: Zephyrine
profile: Hedge mage. Expelled from the Collegium Arcanum over an incident involving the Dean, a duck, and what the enquiry called 'an unsanctioned quantity of fire'.

name: Nix
profile: Runs the back room of the general store. Does not steal things. Locates them, ahead of schedule, on behalf of a client who has not yet been identified.

name: Aldric
profile: A knight errant who arrived in Thistlewick six years ago and has been trying to leave ever since. Has never once found the north gate.

name: Piper
profile: A bard who narrates events as they happen, in the third person, at volume, whether or not this is convenient.

name: Corvin
profile: Has been waiting in the corner of a tavern for a destiny since he was nineteen. His village was destroyed by flooding, in his absence, and everyone was fine, and he cannot make anyone understand.

name: Wren
profile: Does not fight monsters. Documents them. The fighting is a regrettable step in the methodology. Carries seventeen specimen jars and a monograph in progress.

name: Roland
profile: Magnificent, glowing, extremely good at everything, and the protagonist of a much more expensive story. Contractually unavailable for the final dungeon. He is very sorry. He is always very sorry.
